name: Kirchhoff Institute for Physics, Heidelberg University
notes: Facility record at the level needed for ECHo; the 163Ho is produced at ILL Grenoble and ion-implanted at the RISIKO facility in Mainz, neither recorded as a site here.

operator_text.quote: Kirchhoff-Institute for Physics DEPARTMENT OF PHYSICS AND ASTRONOMY HEIDELBERG UNIVERSITY

summary.plain: A physics institute of Heidelberg University, Germany, where the ECHo collaboration builds its ultra-cold magnetic calorimeters to measure the electron neutrino mass from holmium-163 decay.
summary.technical: Kirchhoff-Institut für Physik (KIP), Heidelberg University: coordinates ECHo, fabricates the metallic magnetic calorimeter arrays in its cleanroom.
